title: Account switcher
summary: The menu a long press (hold) on the Você tab opens in place, anchored on the tab (ADR 0135, MZ decision 25 Oct 2026), and the row Contas neste celular on voce opens too: every account on this phone with a check on the current one, then Adicionar conta (bipe_app_account_new, ADR 0086, bipe-chat/bipe#445).

accounts.description: Every account on this phone, oldest first.

canAddAccount.description: true while the phone holds fewer personal accounts than max_accounts (bipe-api GET /v1/me/account, fallback MAX_PERSONAL_ACCOUNTS in the registries). account-new turns its personal row off when false; Adicionar conta shows either way, for a company account or an existing one.

switchAccount.effect: Closes the menu and runs app-tabs switchAccount.

newAccount.effect: Closes the menu and opens account-new. The accounts on the phone stay signed in.

notes: Each row shows the avatar, the display name and the @handle; never the Matrix ID.
An account with unread messages shows a dot in its row.
Company accounts do not count against the cap (ADR 0086).

Avatars show the actual account photo or initials; company accounts use rounded squares and personal/unknown accounts circles (ADR 0132). Selecting the current account dismisses the menu without a switch haptic.

Company accounts made on this phone show under their owner (bipe-chat/bipe#444): each owner with its company accounts is one group, in the order of the owner; a company without an owner on this phone keeps its own place. The indent shows the owner, so a company row does not name it again: under its name it shows its @handle, or bipe_account_work_line when it has none (ADR 0287). The owner is a phone-side grouping only (AccountList, next to the account order): no API field and no other person sees it (ADR 0138 rules 2, 5 and 7).
A company account where this phone is an attendant shows bipe_team_you_here under its name instead of the @handle or bipe_account_work_line (ADR 0252).
